policy.purpose: Manufacturer-documented public factory access values and separately labelled fixed access sequences. Not site credentials, not emulator practice PINs.
policy.siteCodeCaveat: The site code may have been changed. A published factory value does not establish the current site credential; use the authorised site record or maintenance contact if it differs.
policy.scope: Match the exact model, variant, access role and stated firmware/document scope. Unknown or conflicting scope requires clarification.
policy.safety: Use only for authorised maintenance. Knowing an access code does not establish that a test, disablement or configuration change is appropriate. No reset or bypass instructions are supplied.
policy.evidence: All source PDFs were downloaded or reused from earlier source verification and SHA-256 matched on 2026-11-11. Quotes and page positions were checked with Poppler pdftotext. Technical entries remain distinct from emulator training credentials.
